title: 桜花賞の後に・樫の楯へと

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Gah! And I was so close, too! I knew she wouldn't go easy on me.
choice_data_list: G1s are tough nuts to crack.
G1s are tough nuts to crack.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You can say that again. Still, complaining won't get me anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: The next Tiara will be mine. I'm not going to give up, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But the me right now won't cut it. Not to mention, she's also getting stronger.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Just so we're clear, I'm not scared of her or anything. I'm only speaking the truth.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm a long way from being number one. I have to get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sitting here sulking isn't going to do me any good. The Japanese Oaks is just around the corner.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I won't let anyone take the title of Queen of the Oaks away from me! That number one spot is mine!
